pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular sub-polygonal patches with softened vertices. Spatial area of individual patches decreases significantly from the lower neck toward the posterior flank and hindquarters. Edges show a clear but soft pixel gradient.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological lattice. Junction nodes exhibit primarily trifurcation. Pathway thickness remains relatively uniform across the central torso, narrowing as it descends toward the limbs.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the neck and shoulder ridge, corresponding to a short, upright mane.
